reviews.title: Perfect - and cool to the touch
reviews.comment: I did a taste test challenge. I put on the original leather, the original cloth, and these new ones. I used them in combination with one another to see how soft they were, how long I could wear them, and how hot I got with each set. These are by FAR cooler than the leather. And for me personally, not only is the sound much better and isolated than the other two, they literally feel cold. They're very soft, feel like much better quality, and I am done searching.  Someone said that the cups themselves were smaller than the factory, which is completely false. They are identical in size and shape. I have fairly large ears and they cover them completely. So in my opinion, they have the best noise isolation, are as soft or more soft than the original leather, and I found them to be cooler than the other two. Someone could perhaps say that cloth is just as cool, and that would be more on the breathable side, which I would say is a matter of preference. However, if you're looking for the best sound, I can wear these just as long if not longer than the cloth, it's a good decision. Side note: When I say quality, I don't just mean the cooling gel and the silk, the outside plastic/rubber ring is MUCH better than the factory pads.  It's super sturdy and I had almost no issues getting them on.  You have to tug them quite a bit because they're not broken in, but I can tell these will last. I can tell that if people are extra cautious it could be frustrating, but the quality is there, put a little effort into it and it's no problem. I did not use any tools, I got them done in seconds with my fingers only. Highly recommend these to anyone like me.  I'm on the computer every day for work: video conferences, music, sports, all of it. Having the upgraded pads makes a huge difference. I'll keep my cloth ones as backups, but I'll never go back to any pleather.  I also did something similar with my airpods and went with the foam tips.  I think when it comes to headphones, I'll always be upgrading as soon as I buy. To me it's a no brainer.  I only leave reviews when someone completely knocks it out of the park or completely drops the ball LOL. These are in the former category. I did not receive these as a promotion, and despite this ridiculous review, I don't work for them either. They're just deserving of a good and thorough review. At the time of purchase they were like 21 dollars with tax. worth it.
reviews.author: Marissa

reviews.title: Better than competition for a better price
reviews.comment: I bought these and the Wicked Cushions (The brand that every streamer has) and these actually work, like I can definitely feel the cooling gel working and the fabric on the earpads is actually comfortable, the WC have a mesh that pulls on my hair and feels really harsh on the skin. It doesn't change sound more than the WC, but not by much, I feel like give the G Pro X a little more emphasis on Highs than Stock Pads. They were super easy to install, and quality wise they seem good for now.
reviews.author: Molero Family

reviews.title: Great fit and comfort for a great price.
reviews.comment: Bought these to replace my stock earpads as they had begun to crumble and leave little black specks on my ears. This new set feels very plush, has a nice texture that shouldn’t break down like the stock ones do over time. Initially installing them took a couple minutes as they have a little give, but once they were on they look really good, they feel very comfortable, and they provide great coverage for my ears to help keep my music in and external noise out. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Tony G

reviews.title: Comfy and cool
reviews.comment: Pads have nice quality. Better than the ones that come with the headphones. Cooling effect could last longer than it's nice to put on especially when the room is cold.
reviews.author: Caen Aviles

reviews.title: perfect replacement
reviews.comment: I feel this is a perfect ear pad replacement.  I wouldn't say the cooling part is effective.  It does feel cool for maybe 5 minutes...but then it just feels like the standard head cushion.  it fits snug and perfect i feel.  I would recommend to others.  like the fact it comes in custom colors as well. feels durable to last a while.  I wear my headset close to 10 hours a day for work and I would say it meets the comfort of the OEM.  I wouldn't say it is way better than the OEM but sufficient.  the earpad does come with a water dropper and instructions to give a cooler feel on the earpads however Im not inclined to try it.
